battle.name: 四帝之年
battle.brief: 公元69年，羅馬在十二個月內換了四個皇帝：加爾巴、奧托、維提里烏斯與維斯帕先。戰事主軸落在北意大利倫齊亞平原的貝德里亞庫姆，禁衛軍與西班牙、高盧軍團在此兩度交鋒。卡面羅馬標槍是兩軍標準的投射兵器：捅穿大盾後折斷，逼敵人帶著半截槍退回掩體。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 四帝之年是公元69年羅馬帝國的一場全面內戰，交戰雙方並非外國入侵，而是帝國中央與帝國邊軍、各地駐軍之間的權力爭奪，戰線遍及西班牙、不列顛、高盧、萊茵、多瑙河與敘利亞。第一位皇帝加爾巴由西班牙塔拉科納行省的駐軍在公元68年6月推舉，隨後被禁衛軍刺殺；禁衛軍於1月15日把奧托推上帝位，奧托率禁衛軍北上，敗於倫齊亞平原的貝德里亞庫姆而自刎；第三位皇帝維提里烏斯是下萊茵總督，公元69年1月2日被萊茵軍團擁立，其部隊由高盧總督凱基納率領翻越阿爾卑斯山進入意大利，卻在4月被加爾巴從西班牙召回的安托尼烏斯·普里莫斯所率第六勝利、第七寶石等軍團擊敗；第四位皇帝維斯帕先原為猶提亞總督，7月先後獲多瑙河與猶提亞的軍團推舉，元老院於12月授予他奧古斯都名號。這場衝突的特徵是羅馬自身旗幟的分崩離析，沒有任何一方宣稱要廢除帝制，所有參與者都以恢復或奪取皇帝之位為目標。
countriesEn: The Year of the Four Emperors was a full-scale civil war inside the Roman Empire in AD 69. The two sides were not foreign invaders but the imperial centre fighting the frontier armies and the provincial garrisons, and the fighting stretched across Spain, Britain, Gaul, the Rhine, the Danube and Syria. The first emperor, Galba, was acclaimed by the garrison of Tarraconensis in Spain in June AD 68 and was then murdered by the Praetorian Guard. The Guard installed Otho on 15 January, and Otho marched north with it, only to be defeated on the Rhaetian plain at Bedriacum, where he killed himself. The third emperor, Vitellius, was governor of Lower Germany; he was acclaimed by the Rhine legions on 2 January AD 69, and his troops, led by the governor of Gaul Aulus Caecina, crossed the Alps into Italy, only to be beaten in April by Antonius Primus, recalled by Galba from Spain, with the VI Victrix, the VII Gemina and other legions. The fourth emperor, Vespasian, had been governor of Judaea; in July he was acclaimed separately by the Danube and the Judaean armies, and in December the Senate conferred on him the title of Augustus. What characterises the conflict is the fragmentation of the empire's own banners: not one participant ever claimed to abolish the principate, and all of them aimed at recovering or seizing the imperial office.
people: 加爾巴是西班牙貴族出身的老將，公元68年6月被軍團擁立後只統治了約七個月。他指定卡爾普尼烏斯·皮索為養子，卻因此激起禁衛軍的仇恨——皮索被指在一場日耳曼戰役的兵變中屠殺過禁衛軍士兵。公元69年1月1日，加爾巴在羅馬的禁衛軍營中被殺。出身禁衛軍的奧托在1月15日接位並率禁衛軍北征，3月14日在貝德里亞庫姆敗於維提里烏斯的萊茵兵，3月16日在布里克斯盧姆自刎。維提里烏斯是下萊茵總督，1月2日在科隆一帶被萊茵軍團推舉，軍團當時索要金幣酬金，迫使他動用私積應付；他的兄弟阿魯魯斯·維提里烏斯率小股隊伍夜入羅馬，擊潰奧托留守的禁衛軍，一舉扭轉戰局。安托尼烏斯·普里莫斯是加爾巴麾下來自西班牙的將領，率第六勝利與第七寶石軍團翻越阿爾卑斯山，4月23日至24日在貝德里亞庫姆擊敗維提里烏斯系的阿魯魯斯·普勞提烏斯，兵鋒直逼羅馬。真正的仲裁者還有敘利亞總督穆奇亞努斯，他以東方的財力與援軍支持維斯帕先，羅馬城下的僵局正是在他的調停下才沒有演成第二輪血戰；猶提亞戰區的提圖斯則繼續圍攻耶路撒冷，直到公元70年才攻下。
peopleEn: Galba was an elderly general of Spanish aristocratic birth, acclaimed by his troops in June AD 68 and able to hold power for only about seven months. He named Calpurnius Piso as his heir and thereby earned the hatred of the Praetorian Guard, because Piso was blamed for slaughtering guardsmen during a mutiny in a German campaign. On 1 January AD 69 Galba was killed in the Praetorian camp in Rome. Otho, who had come out of the Guard's own ranks, was raised to the throne on 15 January and marched north with it; on 14 March AD 69 he was beaten at Bedriacum by Vitellius's Rhine troops, and on 16 March he killed himself at Brixellum. Vitellius, governor of Lower Germany, was acclaimed by the Rhine legions near Cologne on 2 January, and the soldiers demanded a cash donative that forced him to break into his own reserves; his brother Aulus Vitellius led a small detachment into Rome by night, destroyed the Guard that Otho had left behind and turned the battle around. Marcus Antonius Primus, a commander serving under Galba in Spain, marched the VI Victrix and the VII Gemina over the Alps and on 23–24 April defeated Aulus Plautius's Vitellian forces at Bedriacum, driving straight for Rome. The real arbiter was also Mucianus, governor of Syria, who backed Vespasian with eastern money and reinforcements and prevented the standoff before Rome from degenerating into a second round of street fighting. In Judaea, Titus kept up the siege of Jerusalem, which fell only in AD 70.
kits: 卡面這款羅馬標槍是帝國軍隊投射武器體系的核心：接戰前以齊射壓制敵陣，掩體被壓垮後才以短兵相接。卡上所繪的半米長、槍桿中空的短投槍，屬於近身反甲的輕型變體；軍團實配的標準標槍則是約兩米長的矛形投槍，木柄前端套一枚細長鐵頸。中空設計的好處在於槍體命中盾牌或鎧甲後容易彎折斷裂，斷頭留在盾面，敵兵既難拔出重複投擲，也無法持盾前進，只能縮回掩體重新整理裝備。與標槍並列的還有短劍、佩在左側的匕首、大橢圓盾，以及禁衛軍標誌性的圓盾與較短投槍、百夫長手執的帶刺藤條。攻城與守城器械同樣要緊：扭臂弩砲、矢弩、撞錘與塔架決定圍城戰的節奏，而戰區補給依靠沿海港口的海運與拉韋納分艦隊。公元69年11月米塞努姆分艦隊倒戈，維提里烏斯一時失卻海上運輸與糧秣，成為其敗亡的直接原因。
kitsEn: The pilum shown on the card is the core of the imperial army's system of missile weapons: a volley goes in to crush the enemy line, and only once the cover is broken do the troops close to hand-to-hand fighting. The short, hollow-shafted throwing dart of half a metre depicted on the card is a light close-range anti-armour variant, while the standard pilum actually issued to the legions was a spear-shaped javelin about two metres long, with a slender iron neck fitted to the wooden shaft. The hollow construction has one great advantage: when the shaft strikes a shield or a cuirass it tends to buckle and snap, leaving the head embedded in the shield, so the enemy can neither pull it out and throw it again nor advance behind his scutum, and must fall back behind cover to refit his equipment. Alongside the pilum stood the gladius, the side dagger worn on the left, the large oval scutum, and the Praetorian Guard's characteristic round shield and shorter javelin, together with the centurion's vine staff. Siege and defence equipment mattered just as much: the onager, the bolt-throwers, rams and siege towers set the rhythm of a siege, while theatre supply depended on coastal shipping and the Ravennate fleet. When the Misenumate fleet defected in November AD 69, Vitellius lost the sea lanes and the grain supply in a single stroke, which was the direct cause of his collapse.
tactics: 第一次貝德里亞庫姆戰役中，奧托的禁衛軍自羅馬北行，第十九大隊在夜間行軍時遭凱基納的萊茵騎兵於阿達河一帶夜襲，幾乎全滅。3月14日兩軍在倫齊亞平原列陣，羅馬式的接戰程序照舊進行：標槍齊射、破盾、短兵相接，雙方在平原上互相消耗。奧托在形勢尚未崩壞時聽聞留守羅馬的禁衛軍已被阿魯魯斯·維提里烏斯擊敗，隨即下令退兵，士氣崩潰便由此開始。第二次貝德里亞庫姆戰役於4月23日至24日爆發，普里莫斯率西班牙與高盧軍團自阿爾卑斯山南下，與維提里烏斯系的第二輔助、第一意大利等軍團在克雷莫納附近的明齊奧河一帶交戰；攻破敵營時士兵捨棄沉重的標槍，以盾為階攀上塹壕，第二輔助軍團在戰局崩潰前倒戈，維提里烏斯的戰線迅速瓦解。往後雙方在羅馬城下僵持數月，維斯帕先依靠東方的援軍與海軍支持取勝，維提里烏斯的日耳曼護衛被解除武裝遣散，他自己的武裝侍從在12月的變亂中將他出賣。
tacticsEn: In the First Battle of Bedriacum the Praetorian Guard marched north out of Rome, and the nineteenth cohort was ambushed on the march by night, by Caecina's Rhine cavalry around the Adda river, and was practically wiped out. On 14 March the two armies deployed on the plain of the Rhaetian, and the Roman method of closing went ahead as always: a volley of pila, broken shields, then hand-to-hand fighting, with both sides grinding each other down on the plain. Even before his position had collapsed Otho learned that the Guard he had left in Rome had been beaten by Aulus Vitellius, ordered a withdrawal, and the collapse of morale began there. The Second Battle of Bedriacum was fought on 23–24 April, when Primus brought the Spanish and Gallic legions down over the Alps and engaged the II Adiutrix, the I Italica and the other units of Vitellius's side near the Mincius river outside Cremona. When the enemy camp was stormed the soldiers cast aside the heavy pila and used their shields as steps into the ditch, and the II Adiutrix changed sides just before the collapse, so that Vitellius's line came apart. The two sides then stalemated for months before Rome, and Vespasian won because he had eastern reinforcements and the fleet behind him; Vitellius's German bodyguard was disarmed and dispersed, and in the disorder of December his own armed escort delivered him up.
data: 時間軸：公元68年6月加爾巴在西班牙被推舉；69年1月1日禁衛軍刺殺加爾巴；1月2日萊茵軍團擁立維提里烏斯；1月15日禁衛軍擁立奧托；3月14日至15日第一次貝德里亞庫姆交戰；3月16日奧托在布里克斯盧姆自刎；4月23日至24日第二次貝德里亞庫姆交戰；7月初多瑙河與猶提亞的軍團分別推舉維斯帕先；11月10日米塞努姆海軍倒戈；12月20日維提里烏斯在羅馬城郊被殺；12月下旬維斯帕先進駐羅馬並被元老院授予奧古斯都名號。四位皇帝在位時長相差懸殊：加爾巴約七個月，奧托三個月，維提里烏斯約八個月，維斯帕先十年。兵力方面，蘇托尼努斯記載奧托出羅馬時帶走禁衛軍十七個大隊，總數約一萬七千人上下，其中第十九大隊近千人全滅於阿達河夜襲；普里莫斯的軍隊以第六勝利、第七寶石兩個軍團為主力，輔以騎兵與輔兵。距離方面，自萊茵下游至倫齊亞約九百至一千公里，史家記為四十餘日的強行軍；羅馬至倫齊亞約五百五十公里。
dataEn: The chronology runs as follows: Galba was acclaimed in Spain in June AD 68; the Praetorian Guard murdered him on 1 January AD 69; the Rhine legions acclaimed Vitellius on 2 January; the Guard acclaimed Otho on 15 January; the First Battle of Bedriacum was fought on 14–15 March; Otho killed himself at Brixellum on 16 March; the Second Battle of Bedriacum was fought on 23–24 April; in early July the Danube and the Judaean armies separately acclaimed Vespasian; the fleet at Misenum defected on 10 November; Vitellius was killed outside Rome on 20 December; and Vespasian entered Rome in late December, receiving the title of Augustus from the Senate. The four emperors reigned for very different lengths of time: Galba about seven months, Otho three months, Vitellius about eight months, and Vespasian ten years. On numbers of men, Suetonius records that Otho took seventeen cohorts of the Praetorian Guard out of Rome, a total of about seventeen thousand men, of whom the nineteenth cohort of nearly a thousand was destroyed in the night ambush on the Adda; Primus's force had the VI Victrix and the VII Gemina as its core, with cavalry and auxiliaries. On distances, it is some nine hundred to a thousand kilometres from the Lower Rhine to the Rhaetian plain, a forced march the historians put at a little over forty days, while Rome itself lies about five hundred and fifty kilometres from Bedriacum.
cause: 導火索是公元68年的皇位真空。尼祿在宮廷陰謀中自殺後，元老院與禁衛軍各自在帝國軍與近衛軍中物色可擁立的傀儡，卻始終沒有就繼承人達成共識。萊茵與西班牙的邊軍早已因欠餉與戰功無望而不滿，加爾巴既缺乏治軍威望，又因年邁多疑被軍團視為外來干預；禁衛軍對其養子皮索的仇恨，源於皮索在日耳曼兵變中屠殺禁衛軍士兵的傳聞，令禁衛軍寧願扶植曾是自己同伴的奧托。更深的原因是帝國太大、消息太慢，首都與各個邊疆的駐軍都自認有權決定皇帝人選，而沒有任何一股力量能同時壓住所有軍團。於是每一次解決辦法的做法都製造出下一次叛亂的理由。這場戰爭並非出於任何一方的綱領，而是帝國軍隊政治在沒有繼承制度時必然的崩解。
causeEn: The trigger was the succession vacuum of AD 68. After Nero's suicide in a palace conspiracy, the Senate and the Praetorian Guard each looked for a puppet among the imperial and city troops, but never reached a common agreement on a successor. The frontier armies on the Rhine and in Spain were already aggrieved over arrears of pay and the denial of the rewards their service had earned, and Galba, who lacked military prestige and was old and suspicious, was treated by the soldiers as an outsider. The Guard's hatred of his adopted son Piso, which was said to rest on Piso's slaughter of guardsmen during the mutiny in Germany, made them prefer Otho, who had once been one of their own. The deeper cause was that the empire was too vast and the news too slow: the army in the capital and the armies on every frontier each believed themselves entitled to decide who should be emperor, and no single power could hold all the legions at once. Every expedient for solving the succession created the pretext for the next rebellion. This was not a war fought for any programme, but the inevitable collapse of the army politics of an empire that had no institution of succession.
impact: 其一，羅馬從朱利奧－克勞狄王朝轉入弗拉維王朝，元老院與禁衛軍的權力被重新收編，維斯帕先一系在位的十年被後世視為相對穩定的開端，隨後由提圖斯與圖密善延續至公元96年。其二，軍團決定皇帝人選這件事被徹底公開化，維斯帕先在平定巴達維起義的同時把第二奧古斯都、第十四寶石、第十五原初等軍團調往萊茵，恢復被叛亂掏空的邊防。其三，他解散或分駐了駐紮在羅馬的禁衛軍與軍團，使禁衛軍此後不再是能單獨推翻皇帝的決定者。其四，69年的劫掠、饑荒與海運失序令帝國財政受損，弗拉維王朝初期曾整頓稅制與軍費，但亂局留下的記憶更長久：皇帝本人被殺而無人能問責，說明帝國的權力中樞已從元老院移到了軍營。
impactEn: First, Rome passed from the Julio-Claudian dynasty to the Flavian one, and the authority of the Senate and the Praetorian Guard was reconstituted; the ten years of Vespasian's house are remembered as a comparatively stable opening, continued by Titus and Domitian until AD 96. Second, the fact that the legions made emperors became completely public, and while Vespasian was putting down the Batavian rising he moved the II Augusta, the XIV Gemina, the XV Primigenia and other legions to the Rhine to restore a frontier that the revolt had gutted. Third, he disbanded or dispersed the Praetorian Guard and the legions quartered in Rome, so that the Guard was never again able to overthrow an emperor on its own. Fourth, the plunder, the food shortage and the disorder of the sea lanes in AD 69 damaged imperial finances, and the Flavian government reorganised taxation and military pay in the early years, but the memory of the disorder lasted longer: an emperor had been killed and no one could be held to account, which showed that the empire's centre of power had moved from the Senate to the camp.
result: 四帝之年以權力轉移收場，而非以任何一方的全勝收場。奧托死於布里克斯盧姆，維提里烏斯死於羅馬城郊，加爾巴死在禁衛軍的刀下，僥倖者只有維斯帕先：他以元老院的名義接手帝國，解散靠攏維提里烏斯的四個禁衛軍大隊，令羅馬的城防與糧秣供應恢復常態，並在次年把主力調回萊茵與多瑙河，開啟弗拉維王朝的十一年。戰爭的殘局延伸到公元70年：提圖斯在9月仍圍攻耶路撒冷，北方的巴達維起義則要到71年才被平定。然而這場內戰真正的結局並非誰登上皇位，而是羅馬帝國從此承認一件事：駐軍的忠誠不是資產而是負債，只有當皇帝能同時駕馭各支軍團時，帝國的邊境才真正安全。
resultEn: The Year of the Four Emperors ended in a transfer of power rather than in the total victory of any one side. Otho died at Brixellum, Vitellius died outside Rome, Galba died under the Praetorian blade, and the only survivor was Vespasian, who took the empire in the name of the Senate, disbanded the four Praetorian cohorts that had been Vitellius's creatures, restored the city's defences and the grain traffic to normal, and in the following year moved his main strength back to the Rhine and the Danube, opening the eleven years of the Flavian dynasty. The consequences of the war ran on into AD 70: Titus was still besieging Jerusalem in September, and the Batavian rising in the north was not crushed until AD 71. Yet the true conclusion of this civil war was not who sat on the throne. It was that the Roman Empire had been forced to accept a fact: the loyalty of the garrison is not an asset but a liability, and the frontier is only safe when the emperor can hold every legion in his hand at once.
